title: Rabin Karp Algorithm
statementHtml: Given a string text and a string pattern, implement the Rabin-Karp algorithm to find the starting index of all occurrences of pattern in text. If pattern is not found, return an empty list.
examples:
Input: text = "ababcabcababc", pattern = "abc"


Output: [2, 5, 10]


Expalanation : The pattern "abc" is found at indices 2, 5, and 10 in the text.

Input: text = "hello", pattern = "ll"


Output: [2]


Explanation: The pattern "ll" is found at index 2 in the text.
